prompt: Why does the man say the press needs service ahead of the date on the calendar?
promptZh: 男子為什麼說沖床需要在行事曆所列日期之前保養？

options.text: It is running more hours than originally expected.
options.zh: 設備的運轉時數比原先預期多。
options.whyZh: 夜班增加了時數，沖床將提早達到保養上限。

options.text: The replacement oil came earlier than planned.
options.zh: 換油用的新油比預定更早到。
options.whyZh: 新油已到是安排保養的條件，卻不是時數上限提早達到的原因。

options.text: A test showed that the oil was already dirty.
options.zh: 測試顯示舊油已經變髒。
options.whyZh: 男子按時數判斷，沒說做過油品檢測。
星期六早上仍要用設備，沒有取消。

explanationZh: 夜班增加了時數，沖床將提早達到保養上限。
evidence: Tuesday was our estimate, based on normal use. We added a night shift, so the press will reach its service limit by Friday evening. We go by operating hours, not the date on the calendar.

vocabulary.note: 在保養情境不是店面營業時間，而是設備累積運轉多久。
